sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (U.S.-derived corporate and trust statutes; customary law recognized for land and certain personal matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Convention between the United States of America and the Republic of the Marshall Islands for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income (signed 2006; entered into force 2009)
Compact of Free Association with the United States (1986; Amended Compact in force 2004)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus; in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2023, as amended (RMI AML/CFT Act); Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 36, MIRC), incl. beneficial ownership reporting obligations; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2023; Trust Companies Act 1990 (Title 37, MIRC); Banking Act 1996 (Title 38, MIRC); Registered Agents Licensing Act 2010; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) guidance; FATF Recommendations as adopted by RMI national AML/CFT policy.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized identity and due diligence packet of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (passport, proof of residential address, source-of-wealth summary, professional reference)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed notary public in the country of origin of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (RMI is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention); notarization plus authentication by RMI Consulate/Embassy or, for U.S.-origin documents, U.S. Department of State Authentication followed by RMI consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of draft Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws of the Business Corporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: RMI Registrar of Corporations certification under seal; no external authentication required for internal filings

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and transactional activity history for each UBO and trust settlor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualifying regulated bank of the UBO/settlor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization (or state-level apostille where origin jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention contracting state, followed by RMI consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent letter from the proposed Registered Agent and Registered Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: RMI domestic certification by licensed agent; external authentication not required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Fit-and-proper declarations for directors, officers, and the proposed trust compliance officer (pre-licensing for the Trust Company application)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: RMI Banking Commissioner / Trust Company Licensing Unit
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: RMI domestic filing; notarial attestation of signatures required with Consular Legalization for foreign signatories

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions, FATF grey-list/black-list jurisdictions, and RMI FIU advisories; enhanced due diligence (EDD) mandatory for domestic and foreign PEPs, including written source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring; beneficial ownership must be pierced through corporate, trust, nominee, and bearer-share layers; sanctions and adverse-media screening must be repeated at onboarding, at licensing, and on a continuous risk-based cycle.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (MIRC) online filing system, operated exclusively through MIRC-licensed registered agents (portal: www.mircorporation.org); paper filings accepted at the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All filings must be in English; corporate names must use Latin script only; no Marshallese script requirement; non-English names require a romanized transliteration and, where requested, an English translation; suffixes permitted are Corporation, Incorporated, Company, Limited, and standard abbreviations (Corp., Inc., Co., Ltd.); an RMI domestic name may not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are valid for 30 days and may be renewed once for a further 30 days upon payment of the reservation fee before expiry. Upon rejection, the Registrar will issue a written refusal citing the conflicting token or confusing similarity. The applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the refusal, addressing each cited ground, or may immediately resubmit alternative name options; adverse determinations may be challenged by judicial review in the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Because the proposed entity will use 'Trust' in its business name, final name clearance is conditional on the submission of the Trust Companies Act 1990 license application or a letter of no-objection from the Banking Commissioner.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or hybrid corporate-office model is accepted for the Business Corporation shell provided a licensed registered agent in Majuro maintains the registered office, accepts service of process, and retains the statutory records. However, the licensed trust company activity (fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts) requires substantive commercial substance: a physical office in the RMI or in a jurisdiction expressly approved by the Banking Commissioner, a designated resident or reachable compliance officer, documented AML/CFT procedures, audit-accessible trust records, and board oversight meetings; a purely virtual operation with no substance is not permissible for the Trust Company license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Elevated: approximately 70 percent estimated probability of an on-site regulatory inspection within the first 12 months of obtaining the Trust Company license; unannounced physical inspections by the Banking Commissioner, FIU, or Registrar are a standard supervisory tool for the High_Risk_Special_License tier; desk-based AML reviews are highly likely on an annual basis.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (two name options, 30-day reservation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory Schedule of Fees, Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 36, MIRC)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government filing fee for Articles of Incorporation (expedited 24-hour processing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory expedited filing tariff, Title 36, MIRC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office appointment (first annual term)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for RMI licensed agents; includes service-of-process acceptance and annual statutory filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register setup and initial UBO filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2023

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary AML/CFT risk assessment and policy skeleton for High_Risk_Special_License trust administration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-scope market benchmark (review of UBO packet, sanctions screening, EDD design, policy drafting, 5-7 business days)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Trust Company license pre-application consultation and fit-and-proper review preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Banking Commissioner / Trust Company Licensing Unit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory application and processing fee under the Trust Companies Act 1990 (Title 37, MIRC)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, translation, and consular legalization of UBO and director identity packages
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, translators, and RMI consular/authentication service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial and consular tariff; RMI consular legalization per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal opinion for approval-in-principle of fiduciary trust account (SWIFT wire rails)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for RMI corporate and AML legal opinion; fixed fee for pre-incorporation opinion

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, Sections 18–31; the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation provisions; and the Fiduciary Business Licensing Regulations under the Banking Act 1987
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Corporate Registry Division, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1), accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; the sole incorporator or initial subscriber may issue no-par-value shares, and the corporation must maintain a registered office and resident agent continuously as a condition of registration
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporator’s subscription agreement for 1,000 common shares of no par value be and hereby is accepted in full, that the registered agent’s consent be ratified, and that the registered office located at [•], Majuro, Marshall Islands be and hereby is adopted as the statutory address of the Corporation. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [•] be and hereby is appointed President, [•] as Secretary, and [•] as Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual meeting, with authority to execute banking resolutions, license applications, and such agreements as are necessary for the conduct of fiduciary trust administration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Registry Division, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the corporate index for the proposed corporate name; submit a name reservation request together with written consent from a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; reserve the name for 30 days and obtain a reservation receipt.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Consent and undertaking of the registered agent
Statement of authorized corporate purpose focused on fiduciary administration of discretionary asset protection trusts
Government identification of the initial incorporator and intended director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, the Registrar will issue a notice and the applicant may file for one substitute name within five business days without an additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and Corporate Registry Division, Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation on Form BC-1 setting forth the corporate name, registered office address, resident agent, authorized share structure, fiduciary trust administration purpose, initial director, and limitation of liability; execute the Articles before a notary or execute in counterpart by each incorporator and obtain the registered agent’s countersignature.
required_dossiers: Form BC-1 Articles of Incorporation in original form
Notarized incorporator resolution or written consent
Consent of the registered office provider
Share subscription agreement and subscriber identity records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect notice, correct the stated defects and re-submit the amended pages within fifteen business days; curable defects include signature discrepancies and missing notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing, Fee Payment, and Certificate of Incorporation Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation at the Majuro registry in person or through the registered agent; pay the official filing fee of US$750 by wire to the approved government account; obtain a stamped filing receipt and, after administrative review, receive the official Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation with proof of fee payment
Government treasury wire transfer reference
Power of attorney to the resident agent for fulfilment of statutory formalities
Cover letter from the registered agent requesting certificate issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, pay any shortfall in fees or correct the corporate records within five business days; submit a written advancement request for expedited re-examination after compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Officer Appointments, and Corporate Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary of the Corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene, by unanimous written consent, an organizational meeting of the initial director; adopt the first board resolution approving share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments; appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; execute certificates of incumbency and authorize banking and trust account mandates.
required_dossiers: Written consent in lieu of the organizational meeting
First board resolution
Officer appointment and incumbency certificates
Corporate bank account authorities and fiduciary trust account mandate forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defective resolution may be re-executed under the corporate cure clause and ratified retroactively by a supplemental written consent of the sole director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fiduciary License Pre-Filing and Commercial Occupancy Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance; and the Majuro Business Licensing Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the pre-application for the special fiduciary trust administration license to the Banking Commissioner; file the commercial business license application covering the registered office; arrange fire safety and structural inspections for the professional office and obtain the required occupancy clearance.
required_dossiers: Fiduciary license pre-application form
Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation
Business plan and AML/CFT program
Office lease or occupancy consent
Fire safety and structural inspection certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If licensing deficiencies are identified, respond to the deficiency letter within twenty business days, resubmit the corrected AML/CFT program, and reappear before the licensing authority for final ministerial approval.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; commercial occupancy licensing is coordinated with the Majuro Business Licensing Office
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Special Fiduciary Business License (Trust and Agency Services) authorizing the administration of discretionary asset protection trusts

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority, Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C – Registration only; exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report because the licensed activity is an administrative office use with negligible physical development impact
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC process emissions; sanitary sewage must meet the EPA 2016 Water Quality Standards of BOD not exceeding 30 mg/L and TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L at the municipal tie-in; HVAC systems must be free of ozone-depleting substances; waste handling must comply with the RMI Solid Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued under the Fire Safety Act 1994 covering egress, extinguishing equipment, and emergency lighting; structural load inspection and building occupancy approval by the Majuro Building Code Authority; workplace health clearance under the Workplace Health and Safety Act 2007 confirming electrical safety, office ventilation, and accessibility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance and Banking (Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands); corporate registry maintained by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations (BC) are statutorily tax-exempt and generally do not obtain a Marshall Islands TIN or VAT ID. The formation procedure is: (i) file Articles of Incorporation and an Exempt Company application with the Registrar of Corporations; (ii) pay the annual government service fee; (iii) obtain a Certificate of Good Standing. No further tax registration is mandatory for offshore-exempt activities. If the BC will import goods or be subject to customs transactions, a customs importer/exporter registration with the Revenue and Customs Administration may be required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or domestic classification elections exist under Marshall Islands law. A non-resident BC is automatically exempt from all national income, withholding, capital gains and estate taxes under the Business Corporations Act. Foreign tax classification (e.g., CFC, foreign partnership) is determined solely by the beneficial owner's home country tax law. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized domestically.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable — no real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime is in force. Physical import/export clearances are handled through the RMI Customs Services using paper or pilot electronic submissions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Inapplicable — the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT/GST. There is no 0% export VAT rate or VAT refund regime. Exports of goods may be relieved of import/customs duties when properly declared, but no value-added tax zero-rating claim can be made.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Certificate of Origin (where preferential treatment is claimed)
Inward Remittance Certificate (where proof of foreign payment is required)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT or income tax clawback applies in the absence of a VAT regime. However, fraudulent customs declarations, misdescription of goods, or failure to comply with RMI Customs Act 1990 may result in seizure and forfeiture of goods, non-criminal fines up to USD 10,000, criminal prosecution, and revocation of the company's exempt status by the Registrar of Corporations for serious non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — the RMI has no independent central bank; the US dollar is sole legal tender and the Federal Reserve exercises de facto monetary authority under the Amended Compact of Free Association. The Banking Commissioner supervises licensed banks under the Banking Act 1991 (as amended) and the RMI AML/CFT legislative package, while a designated Financial Intelligence Unit administers suspicious-transaction and currency-reporting obligations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Renewal and Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submitted through the licensed Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: on or before the anniversary date of the original certificate of incorporation; a 30-day grace period is allowed by administrative practice before late charges accrue.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty equal to 10% of the annual fee per commenced month of arrears; if the account remains delinquent for 90 days after the anniversary, the Registrar may administratively strike off the corporation and dissolve it by notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Trust Company License Renewal Application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Banking Commissioner / Financial Institutions Commission, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar rule: application and supporting documents must be received before the existing license expires each year, ordinarily not later than 31 December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew on time automatically terminates the fiduciary license; the corporation must immediately cease trust administration and may be fined up to US$10,000 plus US$100 per day until the renewal is approved or the license is revoked.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance Return and Resident Agent Certification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Intelligence Unit of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the licensed corporation's fiscal year-end; a fiscal-year declaration is recorded in the corporate records at the time of first filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines per breach, up to US$5,000 for a late filing and US$25,000 for non-filing; the FIU may refer persistent violators to the Attorney General and recommend suspension of the trust company license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Compliance Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Banking Commissioner / Financial Institutions Commission, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months (120 days) after the end of each fiscal year, unless the Banking Commissioner grants a written extension for consolidated group reporting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a fixed fine of US$1,000 plus US$500 per month of delay; continued failure for 180 days may result in suspension of the fiduciary license and administrative strike-off of the corporation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size-based exemption applies to the licensed discretionary trust and fiduciary business. Annual independent audit is mandatory for every corporation holding a fiduciary/trust company license, regardless of revenue, assets, or number of shareholders. A non-licensed, non-resident business corporation is not subject to a compulsory audit solely under the Business Corporations Act.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or U.S. GAAP is accepted for ordinary non-resident corporations; IFRS is required for licensed trust companies and for all reports submitted to the Banking Commissioner.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Registered Agent must hold current beneficial-ownership information for the discretionary trust and each settlement trust vesting in the corporation. Share transfers or changes in trust ownership must be recorded in the Register of Members and notified to the Registered Agent within 21 days of the transfer. Annually, the Registered Agent issues a UBO confirmation to the corporate secretary and includes an updated certification in the corporate renewal filing; where the ultimate beneficial owner is the protector or enforcer of an irrevocable spendthrift trust, the legal-persons structure must be disclosed but no public UBO register is established.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$1,200 – US$2,800 per annum for registered office and corporate secretarial maintenance, including the annual renewal processing and AML/CFT record-keeping.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$7,500 – US$15,000 per annum for a licensed offshore trust company with a single discretionary trust portfolio; larger or consolidated fiduciary structures may exceed US$25,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no corporate income tax on any corporation; a non-resident domestic corporation (Business Corporation, BC) is expressly exempted under Section 93 of the Business Corporations Act 1990 from all RMI taxes other than the annual government fee.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate: 0%. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions exist because the baseline corporate tax rate is zero. The only annual charge on the BC is the non-resident corporation annual government maintenance fee (starting at USD 200 for authorized capital of USD 50,000 or less, with the scale capped at USD 1,000 for authorized capital above USD 1,000,000), plus registered agent and FIU-related compliance fees.
